raw_segments.text: A frowsy whore with black straw sailor hat askew came glazily in the day along the key
When first he saw that form endearing, yes it is, I feel so lonely.
Wet night in the lane, horn, who had the hee-haw shessaw off her beat here, what is she, hope
sheaps'd any chance of your wash, new molly, had me decked, stout lady does be with you
in the brown costume, put you off your stroke that, appointment we made knowing we'd never
well hardly ever, too dear too near to home sweet home.
Sees me does she, looks a fright in the day, face like dip, damn her, oh well she has to
live like the rest, look in here.
